idea-plugin.name: MQL5
idea-plugin.description:
MQL5 editing support for .mq5 and .mqh files.

  • Syntax highlighting for keywords, built-in types, functions, constants, input variables and macros.
  • Bundled language server: completion, navigation, references, hover documentation and signature help.
  • API signatures and enum descriptions imported from the official MQL5 CHM reference.
  • Configurable standard-library include paths and optional external compiler bridge.

Language-server features require Node.js 22+ and an IDE with IntelliJ LSP support. Highlighting works without LSP. This is a declaration indexer, not a full MQL5 compiler.

Independent project; not affiliated with JetBrains or MetaQuotes. Licensed under MIT.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.4.3: fixes local HTML reference links and adds CHM documentation for every imported function, including parameters, return values and notes. MIT license and portable build. Includes API overloads, enum documentation and input/macro highlighting.
